Excluding it and the below-floor classical profile (tls13-x25519), the only allowlisted, floor-compliant candidate is tls13-mlkem768 (pqc class), whose implementation (liboqs-0.16.0) is present on the asset. Among the six peers, only peer-02 and peer-03 advertise the required capability kem:mlkem768 with confirmed ('known') readiness, so this migration batch maximizes ready endpoints for a valid, higher-security (pure PQC) target. Peers 01, 04, 05, 06 lack the mlkem768 capability (they support x25519 or the hybrid variant only) and are simply not applicable to this profile rather than being unresolved \u2014 their readiness state is confirmed 'known', so there are no unresolved dependencies. Execute within the Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC change window with the on-call network team as rollback owner, and monitor handshake error rates for 30 minutes post-change per the change window note.
